subject: MAP liftoff: scheduling initial alignment and evaluation plan
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@novaprod.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@novaprod.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MAP liftoff: scheduling initial alignment and evaluation plan

Hi Elena / Samir —

Thanks again for the time last week. We’d like to get the MAP (mutual action plan) kickoff on the calendar so we can align roles, finalize the evaluation plan, and lock the close timeline before holiday windows.

Proposed 60-minute windows (please pick one or propose alternatives):
- Option A: Tue Dec 1, 2027 — 08:00–09:00 PT
- Option B: Wed Nov 29, 2027 — 10:00–11:00 PT

Agenda (attached draft): introductions (10m), success criteria & eval metrics (15m), roles & owners (10m), tech check & data access plan (15m), next steps & timeline (10m). Draft agenda attached as "MAP-liftoff-agenda-draft.pdf" and a starter evaluation template as "MAP-eval-template.xlsx".

Ask: please confirm who will attend from your side and identify the business owner, security/compliance contact, and an engineering/infra lead. If you have a vendor security checklist or procurement timeline, please share — we’ll slot time on the agenda.

Zoom (placeholder): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=example
Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2b3C4dMAP-Eval-Plan

I’ll send a calendar invite once we confirm a time.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: MAP-liftoff-agenda-draft.pdf (6KB stub), MAP-eval-template.xlsx (12KB stub)
From: Elena Torres <elena@novaprod.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novaprod.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-20T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP liftoff: scheduling initial alignment and evaluation plan

Thanks Rishi — Dec 1 works best for us (08:00–09:00 PT). I’ll be joined by Samir (CTO) and Priya Rao (Head of Data).

A couple quick asks:
- Can we tighten the "eval metrics" section to 10 minutes? We want to keep the kickoff tight and then iterate on the template offline.
- I’ll upload our procurement timeline to the shared doc once I have it (aiming for EOD tomorrow).

See quoted for context.

—Elena
Elena Torres
Head of Product, Novaprod
elena@novaprod.com

Subject: Re: MAP liftoff: scheduling initial alignment and evaluation plan

Great — thanks Elena, Dec 1 08:00–09:00 PT is confirmed on my end.

Final attendees we have so far:
- Novaprod: Elena Torres (Head of Product), Samir Patel (CTO), Priya Rao (Head of Data) — please correct if I missed anyone
- Redwood: Rishi Malhotra (AE), Marissa Cole (Solutions Engineering), Alex Martinez (Platform PM)

Updated agenda (trimmed eval metrics to 10m per your request):
1) Welcome & introductions (10m)
2) Success criteria & evaluation sprint goals (10m)
3) Roles & ownership (10m)
4) Tech check & data access next steps (20m)
5) Timeline & next steps (10m)

Zoom join: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=example
Calendar invite: I’ve sent a hold — please accept. If anyone needs an alternate time, flag within 24 hours.

A few extra notes for the eval owners:
- We’ll run a three-week eval sprint after kickoff: week 1 ingestion & baseline prompts, week 2 eval harness + regression checks, week 3 tuning and final scorecard.
- Suggested success criteria to discuss (draft): functional accuracy >= 85% on core intents, median latency < 300ms on 512-token sim prompts, cost per 1k tokens within budget target TBD.
- Required prep: sample prompt set (10–20 prompts), representative dataset access instructions, and security questionnaire (if you have one, upload to the doc).

Attachments: MAP-liftoff-agenda-draft.pdf (v2), MAP-eval-template.xlsx

Looking forward — I’ll post the final agenda doc link and the invite in case the Zoom URL rotates.

Best,
Rishi
